Do you hear that? The constant gunfire? The shelling? And they tell the world there is a ceasefire? There is no pause. No reprieve. No safety for Palestinians in Gaza. On October 11, our team visited families whose tents had been burned, leaving them without shelter once again. Even as we filmed, heavy gunfire echoed around us. This is the reality of life in Gaza. Families who have lost everything continue to live under the threat of violence, yet refuse to be driven from their land. This is what steadfastness looks like. Sumud. A determination that is difficult to comprehend unless you understand what it means to face the loss of your homeland. They have burned their shelters, destroyed their neighborhoods, and displaced them again and again. But they have not broken their connection to Palestine. They are not leaving. They are not surrendering their right to exist on their land. Help support them. The Sameer Project is one of the only organizations that delivers aid in these danger zones. What if a small gift from Gaza could carry a very big thank you? ❤️ Dear Miss Rachel, I am a little girl from Gaza, and this gift comes to you with so much love. We, the children of Echo of the Survivors, made this mural especially for you. It may look like a small gift, but for us, it carries a very big thank you. These children have lost so much, but they have not lost their hope, their love, or their dream to make their voices heard. They wanted to thank you in their own special way. Thank you for standing with us, listening to our voices, and showing love to the children of Palestine. We truly love you, Miss Rachel, and we hope this small gift reaches your heart. We hope you can feel the love, gratitude, and hope behind every brushstroke. ❤️🇵🇸

This video is being shared with the claim that soldiers danced on the bodies of Palestinians they had killed. If authentic, it would be deeply disturbing and would raise serious moral and legal questions. War should never strip people of their humanity. Every civilian death is a tragedy, and any act that degrades the dead or celebrates suffering deserves careful scrutiny and accountability. In conflicts like this, emotions run high, but facts matter. Allegations should be investigated thoroughly, and those responsible for any war crimes or abuses should be held accountable, regardless of who they are. The world cannot become numb to human suffering. Justice should never depend on nationality, religion, or politics. What kind of world are we creating if respect for human life disappears? #Gaza #HumanRights #Accountability #Justice

Даже после объявления перемирия в октябре 2025 года их положение остаётся крайне тяжёлым. 📊 Основные данные о погибших По данным Палестинского центрального бюро статистики, с начала конфликта в октябре 2023 года погибло более 21 283 ребёнка (около 30% всех жертв). Среди них 450 младенцев и 1 029 детей, не доживших до года . 💔 Условия жизни и угрозы Дети страдают не только от прямых боевых действий: · Голод и холод: Зафиксирована гибель 157 детей от голода и 25 — от переохлаждения в палатках . · Ранения: Более 44 000 детей получили ранения, свыше 1 000 — ампутации конечностей . · Сиротство: Около 58 000 детей потеряли одного или обоих родителей . 🏚️ Гуманитарная ситуация Системы жизнеобеспечения разрушены: · Медицина: Около 4 000 детей нуждаются в срочной эвакуации для спасения жизни. Большинство больниц не функционируют . · Образование: 200 000 детей остаются вне школы. Многие вынуждены работать, чтобы помочь семьям выжить . · Быт: 96% семей живут в палатках или разрушенных зданиях. 90% семей были перемещены три и более раз . ⚠️ Нарушение перемирия Несмотря на соглашение о прекращении огня, в среднем один ребёнок погибает каждый день.
